newLeads.evidence: Separately lists Manège Mickey (carrousel), Petit Manège (manège avion, 2015), and Petit Train (train junior).
newLeads.limits: Undated database inventory with obsolete official links and empty image galleries. No documented alias to current Manège enchanté, no post-fire evidence. Do not create, merge or assign dates from similarity.

newLeads.evidence: Manège Mickey, carrousel, for children; opening year and manufacturer unknown.
newLeads.limits: No usable item photo or explicit alias.
No usable photo or connection to either requested item. Not transferable to Manège enchanté or Star Flyer without proof.

newLeads.evidence: Petit Train, train junior, for children.
newLeads.limits: No photo, date or physical specifications.

newLeads.evidence: Brochure carrying 2026 in title/file lists Petit Train with Brocomela and Carrousel.
newLeads.limits: Its May–September, Wednesday and 11h–19h opening information conflicts with the verified current official season. Likely retained older park description; publication/file year does not prove the train operated in 2026. Not accepted for current operation or tariffs.

visualInspection.evidence: Close photograph of children on a vehicle carousel: red/silver toy vehicles, truck and cartoon character, no readable ride-name sign. SOMEPLAS appears on a vehicle body.
visualInspection.limits: No name match to Manège enchanté, no current operation evidence. Component marking alone must not be assigned as manufacturer of the complete ride. Do not import under either item.

visualInspection.evidence: Older aerial photograph shows several rides and structures but no legible requested-item sign.
visualInspection.limits: Do not assign rails, canopies or unnamed structures to Petit Train by proximity.

visualInspection.evidence: Downloaded native version of an existing 2026 panoramic scene for visual reading. Shows blue swing-chair Star Tower and multicoloured wing-gondola Star Flyer, plus other already catalogued rides.
visualInspection.limits: No direct requested-name attribution. This is an alternate size of an already researched scene, not a new import candidate; do not duplicate. Do not call wing gondolas Manège enchanté.

visualInspection.evidence: Read existing 2018 images showing entry, inflatable play structures and coaster.
visualInspection.limits: No qualifying requested-ride identity, visible watermark, no new import proposed.

postFireQualification.parkReopening: Existing confirmed sources establish park reopening on 29 May 2025 and official 2026 season. They do not establish a per-item survival/replacement inventory.
postFireQualification.officialListingLimit: The two item texts/images are unchanged in substance from 2021/2022 archive captures and use the logo placeholder. A live 2026 navigation context does not prove the same physical asset remained.
postFireQualification.sourceConflict: Angers Info 30 May 2025 wrongly calls chair swings Star Flyer; preserve verified Star Tower/Star Flyer separation.
noNewEntities: Do not create Manège Mickey or Petit Manège from the undated secondary database alone.
Do not assign old entry/boutique, duck-fishing or arcade-gallery assets a post-fire current status without dated evidence.
